Title: Support `--json` on the list command

Right now `list` only prints a human table. Please add `--json` so scripts can consume the output.

Expected behavior:
- `python -m tinydb_demo list --json` prints a JSON array of note objects to stdout
- nothing else on stdout (no table, no logs)
- invalid JSON output should never happen, even with unicode or empty notes
- README gets a short usage snippet
